attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) to route between lan-a (node2, vtnet1/opt1) and lan-b (node3, vtnet2/opt2), added a single default-deny-preserving pf pass rule allowing TCP/8080 from lan-a to lan-b, statically addressed node2/node3's second NICs via NetworkManager (persistent), opened firewalld port 8080 on node3, verified only the intended flow is permitted (all other ports/protocols/directions remain refused), then restarted all three nodes one at a time and re-verified boot-identity change and full recovery of network config, firewall rule, and the TCP/8080 path.
